target.title: test(qa): guard unsupported Crabline channels
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

QA runtime currently relies on Crabline channel selection validation from the underlying resolver, but `extensions/qa-lab/src/cli.runtime.test.ts` did not lock that contract with an explicit regression test. That makes it easy for a future refactor to silently widen or change unsupported `--channel-driver crabline --channel ...` behavior.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds focused guardrail coverage for unsupported explicit Crabline channels so QA CLI runtime keeps rejecting them before suite dispatch. The test is table-driven and covers the current unsupported cases (`signal`, `mattermost`, `matrix`) against the real runtime error message.

## User Impact

No product behavior changes. This only hardens test coverage around the existing QA CLI validation contract so unsupported Crabline channel overrides do not regress unnoticed.

## Evidence

- Ran `pnpm install` to restore the missing local Crabline dependency required by the QA extension tests.
- Real console output from the focused verification run:

```bash
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qa-lab/src/cli.runtime.test.ts
[test] starting test/vitest/vitest.extension-qa.config.ts

 RUN  v4.1.8 /home/0668000995/10288592/git-hub/test/openclaw


 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  86 passed (86)
   Start at  22:22:06
   Duration  10.91s (transform 2.60s, setup 415ms, import 5.01s, tests 5.20s, environment 0ms)

[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 21.00s
```

- Coverage added by this PR:
  - `--channel-driver crabline --channel signal` rejects before suite dispatch
  - `--channel-driver crabline --channel mattermost` rejects before suite dispatch
  - `--channel-driver crabline --channel matrix` rejects before suite dispatch
